posts.meta_description:
7,572 likes, 211 comments - kaisafit on October 17, 2026: "I have never felt more understood 😂

Starting to think that maybe being a loner and an introvert is really my superpower, if only I would accept it…

Realizing more & more that it might be time to step into my f*ck around and find out era because this guarded, masked life really tried to take me down. And honestly, what’s more freeing then putting down the walls and just being who the f*ck you are…

Obviously easier said than done because I’ve been wearing this mask for so long that sometimes I can’t tell the difference between me or the version I created... 

**And I’m thankful for her because she protected me and got me this far, but we are done here**

So to everyone that is continuing to put in the work to get to know themselves and evolve, I see you and I feel you. It’s f*cking haaaard but is there really any other option? 🫶".

1,827 likes, 130 comments - kaisafit on October 13, 2026: "If you are ready to get back into movement, I highly suggest you worry LESS about the specific program and more about the schedule.

My biggest goal right now is keeping a time commitment to myself. What I do during that time doesn’t really matter because the goal is simply creating a new routine and sticking with it.

That’s it. That’s step one. Look at your schedule, figure out how many days a week you can move and for how long and then commit to showing up for every single one of those sessions.

What you do during those workouts is FAR less important right now, we’ll get to that in a month or so. But for now, schedule & show up. That’s the goal, that’s the win. We got this! Go Team gooooo 🫶".

9,422 likes, 507 comments - kaisafit on October 11, 2026: "Just Start…

This is me after four months off. Starting w/ mobility and a walk. I set my timer for 30 minutes and told myself to just do what felt good. HUMBLING to say the least but proud. So proud that I started my journey back to movement today. 

The hardest part is always starting. We got this Team 🫶".

2,767 likes, 165 comments - kaisafit on August 3, 2026: "Fun fact: I hate training alone and have never been able to stick to a workout routine that I’m supposed to do on my own.

Another fun fact: I’ve been a trainer for over 15 years and run a fitness company.

Last fun fact: staying consistent with your movement routine means finding something that you actually enjoy doing. Not forcing yourself to do what “fitness people do.” Because most of what you see is smoke and mirrors, just being honest 😁".

1,079 likes, 73 comments - kaisafit on July 2, 2026: "If you don’t enjoy your current routine, maybe it’s not you…

Maybe it’s the routine.

If your workouts feel like a chore, maybe give yourself permission to think less about “working out” and more about just moving! Walk. Swim. Dance. Surf. Hike. Explore. Experiment. 

Because the “best” movement is the one you actually enjoy enough to keep doing! #JustMove".
